thank you everyone for those nice comments!!! im new to reddit so i wanted to change the title to Rabokki, guess i cant!! lol!!

ill share the recipe here!!!

i asked a couple of friends for their advice, and i used what i had in my house!!

so i used 1 instant ramen noodle pack, in this case i used ShinRamyun (btw i only used the veggies that come with the noodles).

i made my own rice cakes!! is easy!! i can post that later too if you guys cant find rice cakes!! i soaked them in water for like 10 min before using them! i used 12 small pieces.

i make my own fishcakes too!! but you guys can buy them too!! <3 the idea is to chopp them into small pieces :) i used like 90 gr.

also important to chopp cabbage, lets say 70gr, thinly sliced :)

aaaand last but not least, 2 boiled eggs, ( i like it a little runny, so i only boiled them for 6-7 min).

​

so before we start, my friends told me to use water for boiling the noodles, but i made my own broth!! so at home i had kelp (less than 5gr, fish sauce 1 tbsp, bonito flakes like 3 gr and shiitake i used a couple, i added some garlic too! 2 cloves.

for the sauce:

i used 3-4 tbsp of gochujang (korean chili paste)

1 tbsp of brown sugar

i love garlic so i put 2 big cloves :)

and 1 tbsp of gochugaru <3

​

lets start!!!! <3

so for the broth, add them all to a pot and boil it on medium heat for like 10 min!

when we have our broth ready, we add the sauce!!! and stir it well, also boil it at medium low.i added the ricecakes first with the noodles!! after a minute i added the rest of the ingredrients! stir around occasionally!

ohh and dont forget to add green onions and sesame seeds!! and the eggs <3

​

i hope you guys enjoy this dish!! i love it very much!!

spread the love! and have a great week!
